facts: The cookies vanished from the kitchen at noon.
Alice baked the cookies this morning.
Bob is a weekend guest who spent the morning in the living room.

timeline: 11:00: Alice bakes a batch of cookies and puts them in the jar on the pantry shelf.
11:30: Bob starts a board game against himself in the living room and writes down every move.
Noon: Alice eats every cookie in the pantry and leaves floury fingerprints on the empty jar.
Just after noon: Alice stuffs her crumby apron into the laundry basket, and Bob sees her through the doorway.
truth.motive: Alice was hungry after baking all morning and could not resist the cookies. She blamed Bob because she was embarrassed.

loc-kitchen.name: Kitchen
facts: The kitchen is warm and smells of baking.
Flour dusts the counter beside an empty baking tray.

loc-living-room.name: Living Room
facts: The living room is cosy, with a sofa and a tall bookshelf.
A board game is laid out on the low table.

char-alice.name: Alice
char-alice.personality: Cheerful and chatty, but she talks too fast when she is nervous.

demeanor.guarded: Bright and helpful, and quick to point at Bob.
demeanor.cornered: Red-faced, staring at her floury hands.
demeanor.cleared: Sheepish and relieved to have owned up.

knows.fact: Bob is staying for the weekend.

appearance: Alice is a tall girl with flour on her nose.

char-bob.name: Bob
char-bob.personality: Quiet and careful, with a love of board games.

knows.fact: Bob plays board games against himself when nobody else will play.

appearance: Bob is a small boy with round glasses.

clue_crumbs.fact: A trail of cookie crumbs runs from the pantry to the back of the kitchen, not towards the living room.

clue_jar.fact: The cookie jar on the pantry shelf is empty, and its lid is covered in floury fingerprints.

clue_apron.fact: Alice's apron is balled up in the laundry basket, and its pocket is full of cookie crumbs.

clue_score_sheet.fact: The board game's score sheet shows a move written in Bob's handwriting every five minutes from half past eleven to half past twelve.

clue_bookshelf_toy.fact: A toy mouse is wedged behind the bookshelf, covered in dust.

alice_blames_bob.fact: Alice says she saw Bob sneak into the kitchen at noon.
alice_blames_bob.why: She wants the blame off herself.

alice_flour.fact: Alice brushes flour off her hands and will not meet your eyes.

alice_noon.fact: Alice says she was in the pantry at noon.

alice_takes_back.fact: Alice admits she never really saw Bob in the kitchen.

alice_confession.fact: Alice admits she ate all the cookies herself and hid her crumby apron in the laundry basket.

bob_alibi.fact: Bob says he was playing a board game in the living room all morning.

bob_saw_apron.fact: Bob says that just after noon he saw Alice stuff her apron into the laundry basket in the kitchen.

bob_cleared.text: Bob is cleared: he was writing down board game moves in the living room all through noon.

culprit_alice.text: Alice ate the cookies and blamed Bob.

facts: An empty cookie jar sits on a flour-dusted counter.
A girl in a striped T-shirt stands by the counter while a boy in round glasses peers in from the living room.
